import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 2000;
    static final int GRID_LIMIT = 12;
    static final int INF_DIST = 1000000000;

    static int[][] distGrid = new int[GRID_LIMIT][GRID_LIMIT];
    static int[][] inputA = new int[GRID_LIMIT][GRID_LIMIT];
    static int[][] inputB = new int[GRID_LIMIT][GRID_LIMIT];
    static List<Integer>[] adjacency = new List[MAX_NODES];
    static List<Integer>[][] exitNodes = new List[GRID_LIMIT][GRID_LIMIT];

    static final int[] dRow = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dCol = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static class BipartiteMatcher {
        int[] leftMatch = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] rightMatch = new int[MAX_NODES];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_NODES];
        int totalMatches;

        int findMaxMatching(int leftSize, List<Integer> adj[]) {
            totalMatches = 0;
            Arrays.fill(leftMatch, -1);
            Arrays.fill(rightMatch, -1);
            for (int u = 0; u < leftSize; ++u) {
                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
                if (tryAugment(u, adj)) ++totalMatches;
            }
            return totalMatches;
        }

        private boolean tryAugment(int u, List<Integer> adj[]) {
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (visited[v]) continue;
                visited[v] = true;
                if (rightMatch[v] == -1 || tryAugment(rightMatch[v], adj)) {
                    leftMatch[u] = v;
                    rightMatch[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static void multiSourceBFS(int startR, int startC) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_LIMIT; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(distGrid[i], -1);
        q.offer(new int[]{startR, startC});
        distGrid[startR][startC] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dRow[i], nc = c + dCol[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID_LIMIT && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID_LIMIT &&
                    inputA[nr][nc] >= 0 && distGrid[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    distGrid[nr][nc] = distGrid[r][c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void expandSearch(int startR, int startC, int count, int maxTime, int[] nodeCounter) {
        int[][] visited = new int[GRID_LIMIT][GRID_LIMIT];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_LIMIT; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], -1);
        q.offer(new int[]{startR, startC});
        visited[startR][startC] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            int limit = Math.min(maxTime, distGrid[r][c]);
            if (visited[r][c] > limit) continue;
            for (int exitId : exitNodes[r][c]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
                    adjacency[nodeCounter[0] + k].add(exitId);
                }
            }
            if (visited[r][c] == limit) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dRow[i], nc = c + dCol[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID_LIMIT && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID_LIMIT &&
                    inputA[nr][nc] >= 0 && visited[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    visited[nr][nc] = visited[r][c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        nodeCounter[0] += count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_LIMIT; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(inputA[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(inputB[i], -1);
            adjacency[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            exitNodes[i] = new ArrayList[GRID_LIMIT];
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID_LIMIT; ++j) {
                exitNodes[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        for (int i = GRID_LIMIT; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
            adjacency[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int startR = -1, startC = -1;

        String dummy = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = (char) System.in.read();
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) inputA[i][j] = c - '0';
                if (c == 'Z') { startR = i; startC = j; }
            }
            System.in.read(); // consume newline
        }

        multiSourceBFS(startR, startC);

        dummy = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = (char) System.in.read();
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) inputB[i][j] = c - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < inputB[i][j]; ++k) {
                    exitNodes[i][j].add(exitNodes[i][j].size());
                }
            }
            System.in.read(); // consume newline
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_LIMIT; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID_LIMIT; ++j)
                if (distGrid[i][j] == -1) distGrid[i][j] = INF_DIST;

        int[] nodeCount = {0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (inputA[i][j] > 0)
                    expandSearch(i, j, inputA[i][j], timeLimit, nodeCount);

        BipartiteMatcher solver = new BipartiteMatcher();
        System.out.println(solver.findMaxMatching(nodeCount[0], adjacency));
    }
}
